paragraphs.text: Shisato (SHEE-sah-toh) was an orochi renegade known for her cunning and ruthlessness. She hunted Dosan 's monks. Her venom was so strong that a few drops could kill another orochi.

When Shisato came of age, it was time for her to choose a tribe, and the warrior caste was the obvious choice. As was tradition, she had to prove her worth through ritual combat. But when she killed her opponent instead of just besting him, she touched off a chain of vendettas. Four orochi warriors fought her to avenge their fallen kin, and Shisato slew all four. Shisato’s venom could kill another orochi in just a few drops, preventing her from participating in the Kashi tribe's rituals.

Shisato was never welcomed by the tribe, although its leader Sosuke acknowledged that she was a skilled hunter and killer. She was simply too ruthless and too deadly; the other orochi feared and distrusted her. Over the years, Shisato grew bitter and lonely and ventured further from the orochi colonies. Eventually, she began to hunt bigger prey: the Jukai Forest’s human monks.
